主题：Return to Office Policy - Effective March 2026
Company-wide RTO policy:

All employees are expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (Monday through Friday). Fully remote employees are exempt from this requirement.

- COO"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_rto_eng_override_5129", "thread_id": "th_rto_eng_5129", "from_": "vp-eng@company.example.com", "to": ["hr-ops@company.example.com"], "subject": "Engineering RTO Adjustment", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true, "date": "2026-03-01T10:00:00Z"}

I've negotiated an adjustment for the Engineering department. Engineering employees only need to be in-office 2 days per week instead of 3. This was approved by the COO.

- VP Engineering"}
